title: Implement composable acyclic YAML graphs and nested components
objective: Deliver release 0.2.0 with YAML-defined acyclic graphs that compose registered nodes and nested graphs through explicit state and port contracts.

branch.name: wi-0002-phase-two-graphs
branch.rationale: The branch isolates WI-0002 implementation and release work.

request.text: Create WI-0002 for langgraph-exec: Deliver release 0.2.0 with YAML-defined acyclic graphs that compose registered nodes and nested graphs through explicit state and port contracts.

scope.name: component-imports
scope.description: Resolve trusted-root YAML imports, aliases, digests, and component dependency cycles.
scope.reason: Composition requires deterministic loading and fail-closed dependency resolution.

scope.name: graph-contract
scope.description: Define graph artifacts with state fields, node instances, port bindings, edges, routes, and reducers.
scope.reason: A graph needs an explicit topology and state contract.

scope.name: langgraph-backend
scope.description: Lower normalized acyclic graph IR into LangGraph StateGraph nodes, edges, reducers, START, and END.
scope.reason: LangGraph is the execution backend for phase-two composition.

scope.name: nested-composition
scope.description: Allow graphs to use phase-one-style nodes and other YAML graphs through public input/output ports.
scope.reason: Complex workflows must be assembled from reusable building blocks.

scope.name: phase-two-tests-release
scope.description: Add graph-specific deterministic tests and repeat the build, link, and CLI release gates.
scope.reason: Composition must be releasable without weakening direct-node evidence.

nonGoals.name: loops
nonGoals.description: Do not accept arbitrary cycles or unbounded back edges.
nonGoals.reason: Explicit loop semantics are phase 3 work.

nonGoals.name: persistence
nonGoals.description: Do not require checkpointing, interrupt/resume, or durable side-effect receipts.

nonGoals.name: compatibility
nonGoals.description: Do not require phase-one node files to remain source-compatible with the revised phase-two node contract.
nonGoals.reason: The compiler must make any migration/version boundary explicit.

nonGoals.name: dynamic-code
nonGoals.description: Do not allow YAML to load arbitrary JavaScript, shell commands, or executable expressions.
nonGoals.reason: Only registered node implementations may execute.

items.name: imports
items.description: A graph can import trusted YAML node/graph artifacts by deterministic relative path and alias.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Missing imports, traversal, duplicate aliases, and import cycles fail before runtime compilation.

items.name: graph-state
items.description: A graph declares state fields, public inputs/outputs, explicit port bindings, and deterministic reducers.
items.reason: Parallel and nested execution need a closed state contract.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Unknown paths, undeclared writes, invalid bindings, and reducer conflicts are rejected.

items.name: acyclic-execution
items.description: A graph compiles and runs fixed and conditional DAG edges through a LangGraph backend.
items.reason: Phase 2 establishes graph execution without loop ambiguity.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Reachable valid DAGs execute deterministically and malformed/cyclic graphs fail closed.

items.name: nested-components
items.description: A graph can use another YAML graph as a public-port subgraph without leaking child private state.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Nested input/output mapping and failure propagation are unit-tested.

items.name: phase-two-tests-link
items.description: The phase includes graph unit tests and a successful user-local CLI link/release gate.
items.reason: Each phase must be independently releasable.

acceptanceCriteria.description: All phase-one regression tests plus phase-two tests pass before v0.2.0 delivery.
